features: DOES NOT CHANGE THE DATABASE SCHEMA AND REWRITES NO DATA — No migration. Plans already issued, balances already written and transfers already recorded stay as they were. What changes is the settlement pair written by the transfers you record from now on, when there is an income item and the share had already passed to whoever leaves with an earlier transfer, and the ancillary charges statement, which is calculated when printed: a statement already printed stays as it was, one printed again has today's figures, also for transfers already recorded.

CHANGES: THE SETTLEMENT OF A SECOND TRANSFER WITH AN INCOME ITEM — When the plan has an income item (for example the antenna rent), the second transfer with «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement) on the same share passed to whoever enters all the income of the days of whoever leaves, not only that of the days after their exit, and the Wallet had the wrong pair. Example: Ines → Sara on 1 July with «Scrivi il conguaglio», the end of Sara's lease on 1 October with «Scrivi il conguaglio», an «Affitto antenna» (antenna rent) of € 500.00 for the whole year next to € 1,200.00 of expenses, both 30 % to the tenant: the pair was a credit of € 15.12 to Sara and a debit of € 15.12 to Ugo, instead of € 52.93. It also happened with a second change of tenant, with an income item ending before the second transfer and with two sales in a row , which write the settlement without the choice (Ugo → Zeta → Mario: a debit of € 87.20 to Zeta instead of a credit of € 1.02, € 88.22 of difference). Now the pair is right, the «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel says it, and the ancillary charges statement, which already said the right figure, agrees with the Wallet, sometimes but for a cent of rounding.

CHANGES: THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT SAYS WHO REIMBURSES WHOM ALSO IN STORIES WITH SEVERAL TRANSFERS — (1) Two changes of tenant in a row, the first with «Scrivi il conguaglio» and the second with «Non scriverlo» (do not write it), and a tenant who entered between the two: the tenant also pays their days after the second change (in the example Pia € 72.59 and Teo € 24.99, before € 90.74 and € 6.84). (2) After «annulla il conguaglio» (cancel the settlement) of a change of tenant and the exit with «Scrivi il conguaglio» of whoever had entered, the tenant who was there in their days reimburses them (Teo € 7.05 to Sara; before, nobody), and the item says «con il cambio d'inquilino del … regolato fra le parti» (with the change of tenant of … settled between the parties), not «con il conguaglio» (with the settlement) as after a change with the settlement written. (3) After two changes with «Scrivi il conguaglio» and «annulla il conguaglio» of the second, whoever entered with the second no longer reimburses the days the parties settled between themselves (before € 90.74). (4) Whoever leaves with «Non scriverlo», comes back with a change of tenant and leaves again, with «Scrivi il conguaglio» or with the settlement cancelled, no longer receives twice the days after the second exit (€ 60.16 in the example). (5) After «annulla il conguaglio» of a change of tenant and the exit with «Scrivi il conguaglio» of whoever had entered, an item starting after the change also follows the pair: the tenant who entered afterwards reimburses it to whoever paid it with the pair (€ 180.00 in the example, an item entirely after the end; an income item is given back to them by whoever took it), and whoever entered with a change with «Scrivi il conguaglio» has it with the settlement, as in the Wallet; and after two changes in a row with the settlement cancelled and the end with «Scrivi il conguaglio» of whoever entered with the second, the tenant who entered afterwards reimburses their days to whoever paid with the pair (€ 30.58), which before the statement left in the instalments of whoever had the row. (6) With the amount already paid recorded as «l'unità (senza persona)» (the unit, without a person), after a change with «Scrivi il conguaglio» and a second change, or the end, with «Non scriverlo», the totals of whoever had the row and of whoever had entered agree with the Wallet (€ 9.08 in the example); the reimbursements with the name were already right. (7) After «annulla il conguaglio» of a change of tenant and the return with «Non scriverlo» of whoever had the row, their later exit is read: the tenant who entered afterwards reimburses their days to whoever paid them (€ 30.58 in the example), instead of being left out.

FIXES: TWO WORDINGS OF THE PRINTED STATEMENT — Where the lease continued with a co-tenant and the settlement of a change of tenant was cancelled, the row of the plan rule says «regolata fra le parti al cambio d'inquilino del …» (settled between the parties at the change of tenant of …), not «alla fine della locazione del …» (at the end of the lease of …). When a tenant who entered afterwards reimburses the same person for days taken partly with the settlement and partly settled between the parties, the row at the bottom says so.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The pairs that the 1.11 betas have already written in a second transfer on the same share, with an income item, are not corrected by themselves: the difference is the part of the income for the days between the two transfers (in the example € 37.81). They are corrected by cancelling the transfer from the unit's history and recording it again, if the history allows it: it does not if another transfer has been recorded on the unit afterwards (that one is cancelled first), if a plan has absorbed the rows or if an instalment passed with the transfer has been issued afterwards, and it says so. Otherwise the Wallet is corrected with two manual balances on the same management, linked to that transfer with «Aggiungi credito» (add credit) and «Aggiungi debito» (add debit) (in the example, a credit of € 37.81 to Sara and a debit of € 37.81 to Ugo); but a sale or a start of lease recorded after that end, before or after the two balances, still reads the pair of then: in the example the panel of the sale says € 10.03 borne by whoever pays in place of the tenant, instead of € 35.09. A transfer recorded before 1.11.0-beta.37 cannot be cancelled from the program nor linked to a balance: the balance is written without a link. (2) After «annulla il conguaglio» of a change of tenant and the end with «Scrivi il conguaglio» of whoever had entered, if whoever had the row comes back, the panel of their return still says that the tenant's share is already in their instalments, while the ancillary charges statement makes them reimburse the days taken with the pair: the statement is what counts. (3) In the statement, the days after an exit that end with a second exit say the date they start from, not the one they end on.
